reviewer: Codex session, review explicitly requested by the user
scope: All positive findings from the current two rubrics, across Mathlib, Tau Ceti and Lean Pool
method: Read every reported finding and checked target source, cited APIs, supporting uses, assumptions, and relevant import dependencies. No source-library changes or replacement compilation.

assessment_meaning.pursue: A source-supported improvement candidate I would pursue; exact replacement remains uncompiled
assessment_meaning.qualified: An optional or incomplete refactoring idea whose compliance with the rubric or net benefit is not established
assessment_meaning.does_not_meet_rubric: I would not accept this finding under the current rubric, for the specific reason given
